describes: How this pack's builders set out a stair (blender/generators/stone.py, the landing rule; the stair kind's plan stage reads it): the risers each keeper lets run unbroken before a landing, and the limits of real practice its codes set. The rules of a stair anywhere (the stride, the going, the rise) are the kind's (kinds/stair.json).

notes.patience: The risers a builder lets run unbroken, a range the flight's set-out draws from, by the keeper's word (upkeep.py's: town, society). Any other keeper is an owner, who builds as they please: ownPatience.
notes.runRisersMax: The limit of real practice: no more than 18 risers between landings (DIN 18065).
notes.runRiseMaxMm: No unbroken run over 3.3 m of rise (Norway's TEK17, section 12-14).
